contributions.detail: Form A is COMPLETELY BLANK at 200 dpi - no ink on any of the ~40 writing lines - and this generation PRINTS NO schedule total, so schedule_total is null and the cover is the only anchor. Cover line 1 reads LAST '1,195 54' (cents written as a superscript over a rule; 1195.54) + THIS a slashed-zero glyph (0 under the repo-wide zero-glyph ruling) = CUMULATIVE '1,195' (written WITHOUT cents). Zero rows equal the THIS cell exactly: a genuine NO-ACTIVITY-THIS-PERIOD report. That is a DIFFERENT SCOPE from the cumulative figure this module publishes, so reconciles_contributions should stay blank - not a failure. ⚠ The cover's own line 1 does not add up as printed: 1,195.54 + 0 = 1,195.54, but the filer wrote 1,195 in the cumulative cell, dropping the 54 cents. Both figures are retained verbatim; nothing was recomputed. Cover line 2 (the $50-or-less aggregate) is EMPTY in all three columns (no glyph at all - blank, not zero), so line 1 alone is the anchor.

expenditures.basis: none - no printed expenditure figure exists on this document
expenditures.detail: Form B is COMPLETELY BLANK at 200 dpi and this generation prints no schedule total, so schedule_total is null. Cover line 3 (total campaign expenses) is EMPTY in ALL THREE columns - the filer wrote nothing, not even a nil mark - and so is line 4 (balance). There is therefore NO printed expenditure figure anywhere on the document to reconcile the empty schedule against, and no printed figure from which to decide the scope: result 'unknown', scope 'unknown', NOT 'exact'. The side is still 'transcribed' rather than withheld, because the page exists and is honestly empty (zero rows is what the document says); what is missing is the anchor, not the parse. Nothing was synthesised by differencing covers or filings.

gates.page_subtotal: No schedule or page subtotal exists to gate against on EITHER sheet - this generation prints none. Contributions were gated on the cover line-1 THIS cell (zero rows = the slashed-zero glyph, closes). Expenditures COULD NOT BE GATED AT ALL: cover line 3 is blank in all three columns and there is no printed figure of any kind for the expenditure side.
gates.row_count: Both pages read at 200 dpi full-page: every writing line on Form A and on Form B is empty. The only marks on p2 are a faint ghost of the cover's 'RECEIVED' stamp bleeding through the sheet behind the column headers - a scan artefact, not ink in a row. 0 rows emitted per side. rowbands not applied: an all-empty ruled sheet has nothing for a row-count check to disagree with, and the visual sweep is the check.
gates.geometry_proof: n/a - zero rows emitted on both sides, so no row geometry is claimed.
gates.balance_chain: CANNOT BE RUN on this filing: cover line 4 (balance at end of period) is EMPTY in all three columns, and line 3 (expenses) is empty too, so there is no beginning/ending balance and no expenditure figure to chain. The only live figure is line 1: prior contributions 1,195.54, none this period, cumulative written 1,195 - which is itself 54 cents short of its own arithmetic (recorded under recon.contributions, retained verbatim). No cross-filing chain is available inside this chunk either: the chunk holds no second filing by Victor Iverson, and its two Brock Belnap filings are from DIFFERENT cycles (2010 and 2018), so the earlier-filing CUMULATIVE-to-TOTALS-FROM-LAST-REPORT test could not be run on any pair here.
